task.ques: Find Tesla Destination Charger closest to the National Air and Space Museum.

claude.final_answer:
FINAL: The closest Tesla Destination Charger is at 1330 Maryland Ave SW, Washington, DC 20024—a 0.8-mile, 19-minute walk from the National Air and Space Museum on the National Mall (650 Jefferson Dr SW), according to Google Maps. Nearby alternatives at 400 and 415 New Jersey Ave NW are 0.9 mile away on foot; 15 E St NW is 1.0 mile.

Verified October 27, 2026. Screenshot evidence: final.png.
Source: https://www.google.com/maps/dir/Smithsonian's+National+Air+and+Space+Museum,+650+Jefferson+Dr+SW,+Washington,+DC+20004,+United+States/Tesla+Destination+Charger,+1330+Maryland+Ave+SW,+Washington,+DC+20024,+United+States/@38.8863138,-77.0251459,16z/am=t/data=!3m1!4b1!4m14!4m13!1m5!1m1!1s0x89b7b7837b262421:0xf8e7c937dd8ce81b!2m2!1d-77.0198164!2d38.8882063!1m5!1m1!1s0x89b7b7759f5c9d0d:0xf5588286aecb2753!2m2!1d-77.0302861!2d38.8836538!3e2?hl=en
